title: NFC Keyboard Emulator server config
description: Server connection settings for NFC Keyboard Emulator, imported as a file or through an nfc-keyboard-emulator://configure?config=<base64url(JSON)> link. Every key except format and version is optional: an absent key leaves that setting unchanged, and an explicit empty string clears it. Unknown keys are ignored.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Ignored by the app.

deviceName.description: Name sent with every message so stations can be told apart. The app trims surrounding whitespace. An absent key leaves the name unchanged; an empty string clears it, which means the OS host name.

enabled.description: Send every scan to the URL.

url.description: Empty, or a well-formed absolute URL. The scheme must be lowercase http or https and a host is required. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating. An absent key leaves the setting unchanged; an empty string clears it.

token.description: Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Only visible ASCII characters (no spaces, control characters or non-ASCII), since the token goes into an HTTP header. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating. An absent key leaves the token unchanged; an empty string clears it.

ws.description: WebSocket settings, shared by stream and request mode.

url.description: Empty, or a well-formed absolute URL. The scheme must be lowercase ws or wss and a host is required. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating. An absent key leaves the setting unchanged; an empty string clears it.

token.description: Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> on the upgrade request. Only visible ASCII characters (no spaces, control characters or non-ASCII), since the token goes into an HTTP header. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating. An absent key leaves the token unchanged; an empty string clears it.

stream.description: Send every scan over the WebSocket.

request.description: Answer scan requests sent by the server.
